events.notes: 11:00–18:00. Travelling Sunday market along the forest's broad, car-free lanes.

events.title: Pure Markt
events.notes: 11:00–18:00. Travelling Sunday market along the forest's broad, car-free lanes.

events.title: Wereldhavendagen
events.notes: Ships, maritime technology and water demonstrations. Saturday offers the fullest family programme and evening show.

events.title: Open Monumentendag
events.notes: Choose one unusual building and one fort, tower or windmill rather than rushing between many sites.

events.title: Prinsjesdag
events.notes: Watch the royal procession and ceremonial activity; verify the route nearer the date.

events.title: Kinderboekenweek
events.notes: Pick one weekend for a library, children's theatre or bookshop event. The 2026 theme is Spot aan!

events.title: Weekend van de Wetenschap
events.notes: Strong family pick: laboratories, universities, museums and normally closed research sites.

events.title: Nacht van de Nacht
events.notes: Book a stargazing evening, dark forest walk or night-animal excursion.

events.title: Halloween
events.notes: Family Halloween trail at a castle, museum, zoo or amusement park; select a daytime session for younger children.

events.title: Diwali Festival Amstelveen
events.notes: 12:00–19:00; free. Indian food, stage performances, workshops, clothing, crafts and children's activities.

events.title: Museumnacht Amsterdam
events.notes: Best for older children or teenagers; choose three venues within walking distance.

events.title: GLOW Eindhoven
events.notes: Free light-art walking route. Go early in the evening and combine with dinner.

events.title: Sint-Maarten
events.notes: Make lanterns, join the local procession and walk the neighbourhood singing route.

events.title: Sinterklaasintocht Amsterdam
events.notes: Parade, music and meeting Sinterklaas. A local arrival may be calmer for small children.

events.title: Amsterdam Light Festival
events.notes: Choose either the walking route or an early canal cruise for the confirmed fifteenth edition.

events.title: Royal Christmas Fair
events.notes: Free Christmas market, choirs and children's activities on Lange Voorhout.

events.title: Amsterdam Winterparadijs
events.notes: Skating, snow activities and children's shows; book a morning session during the Christmas holiday.

events.title: Nationale Tulpendag
events.notes: Free tulip-picking garden from 13:00. Arrive before opening because the queue becomes substantial.

events.title: Lunar/Chinese New Year
events.notes: Chinatown Den Haag or Rotterdam: lion dance, Asian lunch and a cultural activity. Local public programmes may fall on the nearest weekend.

events.title: Carnaval
events.notes: A daytime parade in Oeteldonk or Maastricht; Sunday is the easiest family day.

events.title: International Women's Day
events.notes: Family museum visit and celebratory lunch; move it to 6–7 March if a weekend works better.

events.title: Ramazan Bayramı / Eid al-Fitr
events.notes: Family visits followed by a special lunch, dessert outing or children's activity.

events.title: Keukenhof season
events.notes: Reserve one April weekday or early Sunday. Before 10:30 or after 16:00 is usually calmer.

events.title: NLdoet
events.notes: Pick a child-friendly volunteering activity—community garden, animal shelter or neighbourhood project.

events.title: Holi/Phagwa
events.location: Den Haag — venue to be announced
events.notes: Hold both dates until a local daytime family colour celebration is announced. The exact observance differs by calendar tradition; avoid commercial dance-party listings.

events.title: Easter outing
events.notes: Egg hunt followed by an estate, dune or forest walk and pancake lunch.

events.title: Koningsspelen + 23 Nisan
events.notes: A particularly nice Dutch–Turkish family crossover: school sports followed by a Turkish children's celebration or family meal.

events.title: King's Day
events.notes: Local vrijmarkt, children's games and orange picnic. A neighbourhood event is often easier than central Amsterdam.

events.title: Remembrance Day
events.notes: Attend the local monument ceremony and two-minute silence at 20:00; meaningful rather than recreational.

events.title: Liberation Day
events.notes: Select a child-friendly freedom festival, concert or historical activity.

events.title: Nationale Molendagen
events.location: Kinderdijk, Schiedam or a local windmill
events.notes: Expected second weekend of May; choose Kinderdijk, Schiedam or a working polder mill once the 2027 dates are confirmed.

events.title: Dag van het Kasteel
events.notes: Castle or country-estate day with storytelling, demonstrations and children's activities.

events.title: Turkish Youth and Sports Day
events.notes: Family cycle ride, sports afternoon and Turkish picnic; celebrate on the following weekend if needed.

events.title: Amsterdam Architecture Day
events.notes: Confirmed weekend with open buildings, guided walks, bike rides and other architecture activities.

events.title: Open Garden Days
events.notes: Provisional 2027 dates. Explore normally private canal gardens; children up to 12 are currently listed as free with an adult.

events.title: International Day of Yoga
events.notes: Watch for an Embassy-supported public yoga and Indian cultural programme. Museumplein is based on earlier Netherlands celebrations; the 2027 local event is not yet announced.

events.title: Japan Festival Amstelveen
events.notes: Provisional date based on the festival's usual late-June timing. Check for the official 2027 cultural and culinary programme.

events.title: Keti Koti Festival
events.notes: History, music, food and conversations about freedom and the Dutch slavery past.

events.title: Nijmeegse Vierdaagse
events.notes: Cheer along the route or attend the Friday finish on Via Gladiola rather than attempting the walk itself.

events.title: Open Trein Festijn
events.notes: Enter normally closed trains, locomotives and the Orient Express at the Railway Museum, Utrecht.

events.title: Buitendag Schoorlse Duinen
events.notes: Forest activities, crafts and a sensory nature walk.

events.title: Cinekid Festival
events.notes: Children’s films, games, workshops and media installations, mainly for ages 3–14.

events.title: LEGO World
events.notes: Enormous LEGO builds, play areas and live activities at Jaarbeurs Utrecht. Excellent autumn-holiday outing.

events.title: Nationale Natuurwerkdagen
events.notes: Choose a child-suitable project such as building insect hotels, clearing woodland or maintaining ponds.

events.title: IDFA Junior
events.notes: Select one Dutch-language children’s documentary screening in Amsterdam.

events.title: Christmas Town Valkenburg
events.notes: Underground Christmas markets, illuminated caves and the Christmas parade. Best as a full-day trip.

events.title: Funky Xmas Market
events.notes: Provisional 12:00–18:00 listing for the free festive market with local makers, food and live music.

events.title: Nieuwjaarsduik Scheveningen
events.notes: Participate or watch the spectacle; registration from 10:30 and the dive at 12:00, weather permitting.

events.title: Jumping Amsterdam
events.notes: Dressage, show jumping and an interactive children’s programme at RAI Amsterdam.

events.title: Amsterdam Chocolate Festival
events.notes: Tastings, bean-to-bar demonstrations and nearly 100 chocolate exhibitors from around the world.

events.title: Landelijke Sterrenkijkdagen
events.notes: Reserve the opening evening while the Netherlands locations and complete 2027 programme are still pending.

events.title: Cherry-blossom picnic
events.notes: Provisional window; flowering depends on the weather. Check the official bloom update before going.

events.title: Bloemencorso Bollenstreek
events.notes: Construction days and evening parade, with the main Noordwijk–Haarlem flower parade on 17 April.

events.title: Bloemendagen Anna Paulowna
events.notes: Drive or cycle past more than 100 flower mosaics. An alternative to the busier Bloemencorso.

events.title: Rollende Keukens
events.notes: More than 80 mobile kitchens, unusual dishes and live music in Westerpark; free entrance.

events.title: IVN Slootjesdagen
events.notes: Children use nets and magnifying pots to investigate plants and animals in local waterways.

events.title: Jantje Beton Buitenspeeldag
events.notes: Find a neighbourhood activity or organise an afternoon of traditional street games.

events.title: Varend Corso Westland
events.notes: Around 40 boats decorated with flowers, plants, fruit and vegetables. The Sunday route is expected to head towards Delft via De Lier and Schipluiden; check the route times before visiting.

events.title: Nederlandse Veteranendag
events.notes: Reserve the last Saturday of June for the public programme, military vehicles, music and parade in Den Haag.

events.title: Wonderfeel
events.notes: Relaxed outdoor classical-music festival at Landgoed Groeneveld, with nature activities and a children’s programme; under-18s are free.
